jobs.title: Aoife Planner nightly Drive backup
jobs.what: Snapshots both aoifes-schedule KV blobs (weekly schedule + yearly plan) as dated JSON into Google Drive's 'Aoife Planner Backups' folder
jobs.notes: 3:40 AM, ahead of the 5:00 AM fleet check. /api/plan-get deploys 2026-08-18 — expect a nightly 'PLANNER-BACKUP FAIL … plan' line (and no OK marker) before then; fleet_health.py's planner_backup probe has a matching grace period so it doesn't alert on that known gap

jobs.title: CarMax scraper
jobs.what: Best-value top-trim ICE-SUV finder (11–16k mi) with live KBB/Edmunds valuation of top 3
jobs.notes: Runs in parallel with Dhaka scraper (isolated browse sessions); same stamp-based retry no-op

jobs.title: Dhaka flights scraper
jobs.what: Scrapes Google Flights (BOS→DAC/BKK + Singapore-detour variant), publishes results site, Telegrams on crash
jobs.notes: Retry slots no-op after success via .last_run_date stamp; refuses to start after 5:30 AM

jobs.title: Dhaka hotel award-rate refresh
jobs.what: Scrapes the IST/SIN card-play shortlist (8 properties) and republishes site/hotel_rates.json for the trip site's Stays table
jobs.notes: 5:00 AM is the WAKE time — the job then sleeps a random 0-35 min, so it actually runs 05:00-05:35 (a fixed nightly cadence is itself a bot signature; never jitter EARLIER, that walks into the 04:00 flight slot). Because of that it now ALWAYS finishes after the 5:00 fleet check, which therefore grades YESTERDAY's file — by design, and why that probe allows 96 h. Own browser identity (BROWSE_SESSION=hotels); stands down if a flight run is still active, which is also what keeps the two jobs off each other's shared git index. Uses Browserbase (60 free min/month) for ~26 nights and local Chrome for ~4 paced, scattered nights

jobs.title: Fleet health check (all repos)
jobs.what: 21 data-level probes across every automation (scrapers, GH Actions repos, live sites) → Telegram digest, commits health.json + schedule.json
jobs.notes: The daily "is everything working" check (6:30 AM slot is a no-op retry; all settled before wake-up). One-line ✅ when all healthy; full paste-to-Claude diagnostics when not. Companion daily GitHub Action stamps results onto the GitHub Repos table.

jobs.title: Keep-awake
jobs.what: Prevents system sleep (display may still sleep) so the midnight jobs always fire
jobs.notes: KeepAlive restarts it if it dies; starts on login/reboot

jobs.title: Gemini Notebook podcast drip
jobs.what: Fires Audio+Video Overview generation (3+3/day free-tier quota) for book notebooks in ~/PycharmProjects/notebooklm-library/index.tsv; backlog CLEARED 2026-08-09 (all 39 have podcast+video) so it now no-ops in seconds and only picks up newly added books
jobs.notes: Kaiser burner account via notebooklm-py CLI. Second slot moved 4 PM → 11:30 PM on 2026-08-09: it was a quota hedge that never paid off (04:00 fired 71 generations in 14 runs, 16:00 fired 0 in 13 — reset always landed before 4 AM), and no jobs run in working hours. Now a transient-failure retry, not a quota retry. Idempotent, so a wasted run is free.

jobs.title: Supervisor (mission watcher)
jobs.what: Watches Google Drive supervisor/inbox for MISSION.md files and runs an autonomous aider build loop; pings Telegram
jobs.notes: Idle unless a mission file is dropped in the inbox

jobs.title: T7 drive sync
jobs.what: Syncs files to the T7Files volume on the Samsung T7 drive
jobs.notes: Fleet health probes its launchd exit code daily

jobs.title: Legacy Dhaka cron (8 AM)
jobs.what: Pre-launchd leftover of the Dhaka scraper schedule
jobs.notes: Harmless — .last_run_date stamp makes it log "Already ran today, skipping" — but it bypasses run_daily.sh's 5:30 AM guard on failure days. Candidate for removal (crontab -e).

jobs.title: Time Machine backup
jobs.what: Backs up the Mac to the encrypted T7Backup volume on the Samsung T7
jobs.notes: T7 must stay plugged in. TM cannot back up the T7 itself — photos' 2nd copy is iCloud only.

jobs.title: Notion health stamping
jobs.mechanism: GitHub Actions health.yml in github-notion-sync (cloud, not the Mac)
jobs.what: Reads health.json + schedule.json pushed by the 5 AM fleet check; stamps the GitHub Repos table and rebuilds the Mac Mini Schedule table
jobs.notes: Dead-Mac watchdog: fails loudly if health.json is >2 days stale (i.e., the Mac-side check stopped running)
